name: agent-board
description: A local board for coding agents: shared progress, persistent questions and live replies. Optional Claude Code pane.

language.title: Pane language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; or pick English, 繁體中文, 简体中文.

autoConnect.title: Connect other agents automatically
autoConnect.description: Optional Claude Code inbox connector for installed agents. This is separate from the independent setup-agent installer and Antigravity native hooks. /progress connect remove also disables auto-connect.
